subject: MAP: Integration Build Plan — SDK, Streaming & Tooling (Draft)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Todd Richardson <todd.richardson@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Integration Build Plan — SDK, Streaming & Tooling (Draft)

Hi Todd / Priya,

Great to speak with you earlier — thanks for the time and for walking us through Acme’s integration priorities. Per our call, I’m attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focusing on the Integration Build Plan milestone: SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, and structured outputs.

Key asks in this draft:
- Milestones: SDK integration PoC, streaming validation, tool-calling prototype, structured outputs schema
- Owners: Acme owners indicated where available; Redwood owners suggested for technical checkpoints
- Target close date for the MAP: 2027-06-30 (aligns with procurement timeline)
- Dependencies: API key provisioning, VPC connectivity window, data/sample prompt set

Next steps: please confirm owner names and any missing dependencies by EOD Wednesday so we can iterate the MAP and lock milestone dates. I’ve included Ben (solutions) and Dylan (eng) to help scope the technical deliverables.

Attachment: ACME_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft)

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

From: Todd Richardson <todd.richardson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration Build Plan — SDK, Streaming & Tooling (Draft)

Marissa,

Thanks for the draft and the clear summary. High level feedback from our side:
- Target close date 2027-06-30 looks ambitious but achievable if we get API keys and network setup this week.
- We’d like stronger ownership on the streaming validation step — can Redwood lead that and provide a short test harness?
- For tool calling, our product team wants a sample flow where the model calls our internal inventory service; I’ve CC’d Priya who will own that side.
- Attachment looks good; I made a few inline comments in the Drive doc (shared link below).

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/abc123/view

Todd

Subject: Re: MAP: Integration Build Plan — SDK, Streaming & Tooling (Draft)

Marissa / Dylan,

Saw Todd’s ask — Redwood should definitely own the streaming validation and provide a small test harness. Suggest the following internal owners and deliverables so we can present a tighter MAP update: 
- Streaming validation (test harness + perf targets): Owner = Dylan Brooks (Eng) — deliverable by 2027-05-24
- SDK integration PoC (sample app + docs): Owner = Ben Carter (Solutions) with dev support — deliverable by 2027-05-31
- Tool-calling prototype (inventory service demo + auth flow): Owner = Dylan Brooks + Laura Bennett (Product) — deliverable by 2027-06-07
- Structured outputs schema (fields, example JSON, validation tests): Owner = Laura Bennett — deliverable by 2027-05-21

Dependencies we need from Acme: API keys and a test environment (or temporary creds) by 2027-05-14; network/VPC window dates; sample prompt and example inventory endpoints.

I’ll draft an updated MAP with these owners and dates and send back to Marissa to share.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Todd Richardson <todd.richardson@acme.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP v1.1: Integration Build Plan — owners & milestones (Updated)

Todd / Priya,

Thanks for the quick feedback and Priya for picking up the tool-calling ownership. Attached is MAP v1.1 reflecting the internal owners and milestone dates Ben outlined. Highlights:
- Streaming validation: Dylan Brooks (Redwood) — test harness + perf targets by 2027-05-24
- SDK integration PoC: Ben Carter (Redwood) — sample app + docs by 2027-05-31
- Tool-calling prototype: Dylan Brooks + Priya Singh — inventory demo + auth flow by 2027-06-07
- Structured outputs schema: Laura Bennett (Redwood) — schema + validation by 2027-05-21
- Target MAP close: 2027-06-30 (pending procurement)

Open items for Acme (blocking):
1) API keys / temp creds for test environment — requested by 2027-05-14 (still pending)
2) VPC connect window — please propose two 4-hour windows next week
3) Sample inventory endpoint + example prompts for tool-calling prototype

Attachments: ACME_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf, integration_schema.png

Can you confirm owners and the three open items by EOD Monday? We’ll treat any missing dependency as a schedule risk in the MAP and propose fallbacks.

Best,
Marissa
